name: disciple_empyrean
description: an Ecclesiastic, the Empyrean's disciple, a young cleric of Lugus: short blond hair, a clean-shaven open face, a long sky-blue robe with gold trim, a white collar and stole, a gold sun-disc pendant, a white sash, brown boots, a lit brass lantern hanging from the hooked top of a wooden pole held up in his LEFT hand, its flame solid bright yellow and white pixels, and a small rolled white scroll in his RIGHT hand at his belt
hands: the lantern pole stays in his left hand on the screen-right side with the lit lantern hanging from its hooked top, and his right hand on the screen-left side keeps hold of the rolled white scroll

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the white scroll flung out to the left in his right hand, the lantern pole thrown up and out, the lit lantern swinging on its hook)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the lantern pole dipping, the scroll still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the lantern pole flung up, the arm with the scroll drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the lantern pole lowering, the lantern swinging
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the lantern pole leaning down with the brass lantern resting on the ground, the arm with the scroll hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the lantern pole slips out of the hand, the scroll drops, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the lantern pole lies on the ground at the lower-right, the brass lantern on its side, its flame dimmed; the scroll lies beside him; the sky-blue robe spread around his legs
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the blue robe settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the lantern pole on the ground beside him, the lantern's flame out
